outcome: Successful trial of vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
cohort: 54 women eligible for Trial of Labor After Cesarean delivery (TOLAC) were included in the study.
finding: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) was successful in 75.93% of the participants.
mod_finding: Trial of labour after cesarean delivery was successful in 75.93% of the participants.
